newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-STRAWBERRY SAYS HE WILL PLAY DESPITE FRACTURED TOE.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-STRAWBERRY SAYS HE WILL PLAY DESPITE FRACTURED TOE.

text.p: New York Yankees slugger Darryl Strawberry, who hit three homers in the American League Championship Series, has a hairline fracture of his right big toe but expects to play in the World Series opener Saturday.
Strawberry suffered the injury when he fouled a pitch off his foot in the sixth inning of Sunday's series-clinching 6-4 victory over the Orioles in Baltimore.
X-rays taken on Strawberry's big toe Monday were negative and the injury was diagnosed as a severe bruise. A second set of tests, done at Strawberry's insistence, revealed the hairline fracture.
"I expect to play Saturday," Strawberry said Wednesday after working out at Yankee Stadium. "The World Series is something nobody likes to miss."

Manager Joe Torre said the five-day break for the Yankees, who await the winner of the National League Championship Series between the Atlanta Braves and St Louis Cardinals, will likely be enough for Strawberry to recover.
"I would think that Darryl will be fine, although he was in a lot of pain after it happened," said Torre. "We're hoping in a couple of days the toe should calm down."

Yankee team physician Dr Stuart Hershon said: "We have fashioned a special shoe for him and he took batting practice with a very good result today. His toe will be taped and will have a protective shield on it.
"There is a very small possibility of hurting it worse and perhaps having to have surgery and putting in a pin."
"I don't even think of the possibility of not playing," he said. "I couldn't play today, but with two more days and all day Saturday I expect to play the outfield Saturday.
"Once the game starts and the crowd gets into it I will forget about the foot and just play."
Strawberry, signed by the Yankees in July after a stint with the independent Northern League's St Paul Saints, is batting .294 (5-for-17) with three homers and five RBI in six post-season games.
Strawberry hit .262 with 11 homers and 36 RBI in 63 games for New York this season.
